senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (चोरयति)
To steal, to rob:
according to some it is also r. 1st cl. (चोरति.)
This root gives its name to the 10th class, which is thence called चुरादि;
(ई) चुरी r. 4th cl. (चूर्य्यते)
To burn.

f. (-रा)
Theft, stealing.
E.
चुर to steal, affix क, fem. affix टाप्.

(इ,) चूरी r. 1st cl. (चूर्य्यते)
To burn.

f. (-री)
A small well.
E.
चु, ट to be shallow, affixes क and ङीष्; ट changed to र.

r. 1st cl. (चूर्णयति)
1 To contract, to shrink, to close as an eye, to wink.
2 To throw, to send or direct.
3 To grind or pound.

mn. (-र्णः-र्णं)
1 Powder, any pulverulent or minute division of substance.
2 Chalk, lime.
3 Aromatic powder, pounded Sandal, &c.
4 Pounded camphor.
f. (-र्णी)
1 A Cowri, the shell used as a coin.
2 Selection of an unanswerable argument.
3 A river in Bengal.
4 The red powder scattered at the Holi festival.
5 Dust: see चूर्णि.
E.
चूर्ण to pound, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
Grain fried and pounded.
n. (-कं)
Expounding in prose the purport of a foregoing verse, an order or interpretation or prose not abounding in compound words.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
A lime-burner^1, a maker of lime.
E.
चूर्ण, and कार who makes.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-लः)
A lock of hair, a curl or curling hair.
E.
चूर्ण what contracts, and कुन्तल hair.

m. (-ण्डः)
Pebble, gravel, hardened fragments of earth or brick; limestone nodule, commonly known in India by the name of Concar.
E.
चूर्ण dust, and खण्ड fragment.

f. (-ता)
Pulverulence, comminution, the state of dust or powder.
E.
चूर्ण with तल् affix; also त्व, चूर्णत्वं.

m. (-दः)
Vermilion.
E.
चूर्णं, and पारद quicksilver.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A handful of perfume or powder.
E.
चर्ण, and मुष्टि handful.

m. (-र्णिः)
A sum of 100 Cowries, the small shells used as coin.
2 A selection or picking out of an unanswerable argument.
2 The grammar of PATAÑJALA, a comment on PĀṆINI'S grammar.
E.
चर to go, to pass, (current,) नि Uṇādi affix, and ऊ substituted for the radical vowel, or चूर्ण to direct, &c. affix कि.

f. (-का)
Fried and ground rice.
E.
चूर्ण to pound, वुन् affix, and the feminine form.

m. (-कृत्)
An annotator, commentator, &c.
E.
चूर्णि selecting, picking out, (meanings or corroborative passages,) and कृत who makes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ground, pounded, reduced to dust or powder.
3 Squeezed, smashed.
E.
चूर्ण to pound, क्त aff.

mfn. (-णी-र्णिनी-र्णि)
Made or mixed up with any thing powdered or pounded.
E.
चूर्ण powder, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reduced to dust or powder, pounded, beaten to pieces.
E.
चूर्ण, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Going.
E.
चर to go, क्तिन् affix, deriv. irr.
